title: Focus Area Balance Across Habits
dataSources: Habit activity (`lifeos:habit`), streaks (`lifeos:streak`), Beeminder goals (`lifeos:beeminder`), OKRs (`lifeos:okr`), planning syncs (`lifeos:ops`).
app: Personal life-OS telemetry — Habitica quest logs, Streaks app habit chains, Beeminder goal data, and personal OKR reviews — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, exports, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=lifeos:habit focus_area=*
| stats count as items by focus_area
| eventstats sum(items) as total
| eval share_pct=round(100*items/total,1)
| sort - share_pct
description: Shows how habit completions split across focus area for focus-area balance.
value: Share-of-total views make it easier to see imbalance, over-concentration, and neglected areas inside focus-area balance.
implementation: Capture each habit completions event in `lifeos:habit` and normalize `focus_area` so Splunk can compute the share by focus area.
visualization: Table of focus area with item count and share percentage.
grandmaExplanation: It reminds how habit completions are divided across focus area so you can tell if one part of focus-area balance is taking over.
